## BFGLSS Chapter 3 Problem 3

Consider two individuals with endowments of $T=60$ hours (per week) of leisure time, nonlabour income of Y, and a wage of \$20 per hour.  At this wage, assume that workers are constrained by their employers to work 40 hours per week or not at all.

a. On a carefully labelled diagram, show the equilibrium for a worker for whom 40 hours is the optimum labour supply and a worker who would like to work 20 hours, but still prefers the 40-hour week to not working.  Compare the marginal rates of substitution for these individuals at 40 hours per week.


## BFGLSS Chapter 3 Problem 3
b. The average part-time wage is \$18 per hour (with flexible hours), in contrast to the \$20 wage for full-time workers.  Using the above model, provide an explanation for this difference in wage rates.
